title: ResearchTraceV1
description: Portable trace document for a ResearchWorkspaceBundleV1 run. Records the ordered sequence of execution events emitted by the chain so the run can be inspected and replayed. Event metadata beyond the core required fields is permitted (additionalProperties: true) so adapters can attach arbitrary provenance without breaking the contract.

chain_id.description: Identifier of the NodeChain chain (blueprint) that produced the trace.

events.description: Ordered sequence of execution events. Order IS semantically meaningful (this is a chronological trace), so it is NOT subject to set-like canonicalization.

step_id.description: Monotonic step index within the run.

node_id.description: Node id of the step that emitted the event.

actor.description: Identity of the actor that emitted the event (node id, adapter name, or 'orchestrator').

total_cost_usd.description: Aggregate cost of the run in USD, if known.

total_duration_ms.description: Aggregate wall-clock duration of the run in milliseconds, if known.

summary.description: Optional free-form summary statistics about the trace.
